property_summary: For every call to transferOwnership(newOwner) made by the current owner, the call must succeed and owner() must become the fuzzed newOwner (only the zero address is rejected); the buggy version inverts the guard so it rejects every non-zero newOwner and only allows address(0).
change_summary: Weaken the nonzero-newOwner guard by requiring `newOwner == address(0)` instead of `newOwner != address(0)`.
